interventions.detail: Installed CPU torch 2.7.1 wheels and dropped cuequivariance*, triton, deepspeed from requirements.txt
Used uv-managed Python 3.12 (with Python.h) so scikit-learn-extra 0.3.0 builds from source
layers.py: default LAYERNORM_TYPE to torch when CUDA is unavailable (fused layernorm is a CUDA JIT kernel)
runner/inference.py: force torch triangle attention/multiplicative kernels when no CUDA device (CLI defaults to cuequivariance)
Export LAYERNORM_TYPE=torch in env.sh for CPU runs
